For each pair of consecutive vehicles on the same lane (sorted by position), compute: gap = leader_pos - follower_pos - 5.0 (vehicle length). A violation occurs when gap < follower_speed * 1.0 (1-second rule). Count total violations per edge across all timesteps. Answer format: <edge_id>
